# DFT Indonesia (PT Dried Fruits Total Indonesia)

> B2B manufacturer and exporter of dehydrated tropical dried fruits from Indonesia. OEM and private label, MOQ 800kg (1 pallet). HACCP, Halal, USDA Organic and EU Organic certified. Export to 18+ countries.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Company overview, capabilities, and certifications.
- [About](/about): Company history, team, facility, and production capacity.
- [Products](/products): Catalog of wholesale dried tropical fruits.
- [Private Label](/private-label): OEM and private label manufacturing services.
- [Catalog](/catalog): Downloadable product catalog for importers.
- [Samples](/samples): Request free product samples.
- [Certifications](/certifications): USDA Organic, EU Organic, HACCP, and Halal certifications.
- [Shipping & Export](/shipping): Incoterms, lead times, documentation, and container loading.
- [Storage Guide](/storage-guide): Storage and handling guidelines for dried fruit.
- [FAQ](/faq): Wholesale, MOQ, payment, and shipping FAQs.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, phone, WhatsApp (+62 811 8797 070), and factory address.

## Products

- [Dried Mango](/products/dried-fruits/dried-mango): Wholesale dried mango chunks and slices.
- [Dried Pineapple](/products/dried-fruits/dried-pineapple): Wholesale dried pineapple rings and chunks.
- [Dried Banana](/products/dried-fruits/dried-banana): Vacuum-fried and dehydrated banana products.
- [Dried Coconut](/products/dried-fruits/dried-coconut): Desiccated and toasted coconut.
- [Dried Papaya](/products/dried-fruits/dried-papaya): Dried papaya chunks for bulk export.
- [Dried Dragon Fruit](/products/dried-fruits/dried-dragon-fruit): Freeze-dried and dehydrated dragon fruit.
- [Dried Jackfruit](/products/dried-fruits/dried-jackfruit): Dried jackfruit chips and pieces.
- [Dried Breadfruit](/products/dried-fruits/dried-breadfruit): Dried breadfruit slices.
